==Original Dream Journal Entry That Inspired The Episode==
I induced lucidity via sleep paralysis. A Were-Rhino challenged me to box for my Reality Warping Stone. (This dream takes place in the same continuity of lucid dreams that started on 06/11/2025 and has continued to the present. These dreams take place in the Elven Village that resembles huts of wood and white stone, as well as castles, and is located in a forest of tall pine trees.) (Were-Rhinos resemble humanoid rhinos.) (The Reality Warping Stone resembles a jagged diamond that is half pink and half yellow.)

A mysterious dust made me start coughing uncontrollably. (This dust made me cough in the waking world. I actually had to get up and drink water, but it wasn't helpful. The dust in the dream was legitimately disturbing me.)

Johnson and I had to portal away to escape the strange dust. (Johnson resembles an orange, humanoid goldfish. He wears a blue astronaut suit but his suit doesn't have a helmet.) (The dust actually stopped bothering us once we escaped through the portal. It does seem like there was something wrong with where we were, but it didn't affect the Were-Rhino.)
